Test Scenario: Go On Duty after a passed pre-trip checklist
Preconditions: Logged in as Courier 1, Off Duty, at HUB-QC, location allowed.
Test Steps:
1. Tap Go On Duty.
2. Mark all 5 checklist items OK and submit.
3. As Logistics 1, open the courier list.
Test Data: Tires, Lights, Brakes, Fuel, Cargo door lock: all OK
Expected Result: Courier 1 is On Duty. Logistics 1 sees Courier 1 On Duty with the current location and the checklist time.
Remarks: Out of scope: the app has no courier login (see ERP Changes sheet).

Preconditions: Logged in as Courier 1, Off Duty.
Test Steps:
1. Tap Go On Duty, mark Brakes Not OK with no note and submit.
2. Add the note and submit.
3. As Logistics 1, check notifications and Assign Courier.
Test Data: Note: Brake pedal feels soft, needs checking.
Expected Result: Step 1 is blocked: a note is required. Step 2: Courier 1 stays Off Duty and cannot be assigned. Logistics 1 is notified with the item and the note.
Remarks: Out of scope: the app has no courier login (see ERP Changes sheet).

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Location permission needed to go On Duty
Preconditions: Logged in as Courier 1, Off Duty. Location access for the app is set to Don't Allow.
Test Steps:
1. Tap Go On Duty.
2. Allow location 'While using the app' (and 'All the time' if asked) and tap Go On Duty again.
Expected Result: Step 1 is blocked with a message that location is needed and a link to Settings; no crash. Step 2 continues to the checklist.
Remarks: Out of scope: the app has no courier login (see ERP Changes sheet).

Preconditions: Logged in as Courier 1 (Active, On Duty, no active trip).
Test Steps:
1. Swipe the app away from recent apps.
2. Wait 5 minutes. As Logistics 1, open the courier list and Assign Courier.
3. Reopen the courier app.
Expected Result: Within 5 minutes Courier 1 shows Offline (or 'location unknown') and cannot be assigned. Reopening the app shows the duty status clearly.
Remarks: Out of scope: the app has no courier login (see ERP Changes sheet).
